text:
The blocks force the order. Ben is immediately after Gus and Hana is immediately after Ben, so Gus–Ben–Hana is one consecutive block. Dev is immediately after Ivo. Exactly one person sits between Ben and Cara, so Cara is either immediately before Gus or immediately after Hana.

Cara-after-Hana leaves no slot for Finn after Gus, or it collides with Ann before Ivo and Elif at least three slots from Ben. Cara-before-Gus only fits one way: Ivo in 2 (Ann must be before him), Dev in 3, Elif in 4 (before Hana, and exactly three slots from Ben), then Cara–Gus–Ben–Hana, with Finn last.

That ordering meets every ordering and gap constraint, and it is the only one that does.
